name: Gasthof Dorferwirt
beschreibung:
Set in the picturesque high valley of Wildschoenau, Dorferwirt welcomes visitors with cosy guestrooms and outstanding regional gastronomy. It offers genuine Tyrolean comfort.

The Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschoenau ski area and extensive hiking networks start right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Gasthof Dorferwirt in Wildschoenau captivates with authentic Tyrolean inn hospitality.
